channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Don't Miss Out! AGM TONIGHT at 8pm in Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us tonight at 8pm in Claremont Stadium for the Navan Badminton Club AGM. Have your say in the future of the club and help us kick off a fantastic new season!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 10 of Summer Club: The Grand Finale!
item.description: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for the grand finale of Summer Club Week 10. Enjoy three hours of fun and games for just €8! Stay tuned for updates on our regular season return.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Hello, Badminton Players! 🏸✨
item.description: Join us for the penultimate week of our Summer Club at Claremont Stadium. Enjoy three hours of exciting badminton for just €8!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Our Summer Club Tonight at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Experience Olympic-level fun at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for just €8. Watch local Olympians in action!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Us Tonight for Badminton Fun at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for a fun evening of badminton! For just €8, you can hit shuttles like a pro, move around the court with ease, and have a great time. See you on the court tonight!
